title: Jupiter Wagons bags Rs 97.66 crore order from GATX India
text:
Jupiter Wagons bags Rs 97.66 crore order from GATX India
Jupiter Wagons said it has received a letter of award worth Rs 97.66 crore from GATX India for the supply of freight wagons on lease, the company said in an exchange filing.
The order will be executed over the current financial year.
